name: Humayun Azad
contribution: Humayun Azad was a Bengali poet, novelist, linguist, and academic whose writing challenged orthodoxy and examined power, language, and social hierarchy.
context: At the University of Dhaka and in public literary debate, he combined scholarship with an openly critical literary voice.
impact: His work expanded the space for secular, rationalist, and formally inventive writing in contemporary Bangla literature.
